svg.title: The check of the release app
svg.desc: Before a bot asks for a token of the release app, it checks that the repository names the app in the variable RELEASE_AUTOMATION_CLIENT_ID and has its private key in the environment release. With both, it asks for the token and does its work. Without one, it says in an annotation and in its summary which one is missing and that the checklist sets it up. A bot whose work is what the app does, such as the blueprint bot, the settings bot or Renovate, then fails; one that only helps a pull request along, such as the fix bot or the branch bot, warns and goes on without the token.
